name: stingray
description: A Claude Code Stop hook for the turn that ends half-done: nothing done, an announced action never carried out, or a promise to watch CI with nothing polling.

plugins.name: stingray
plugins.description: Installs the Stop hook. Off until you set a switch: STINGRAY_SHAPE3=1 for the local check alone, STINGRAY_SHADOW=1 to record without blocking, STINGRAY=1 to block.
